release.content: pubtest 0.2.1 was released on 2026-11-17 from commit ee4cb1cc40fa1f03437be2f885b409a422ecf233 with these changes.

rows: The suite-ctx scenario's inner suite no longer turns off a pytest plugin named pubkit, which nothing installs since pubkit became pubrules

More steps: the JSON and matched lines a program prints, a text result matched by a pattern (only `*` is special), YAML files, files copied from the repository, executable files and what a directory holds, fake services' headers and counts, requests with headers and any method's body or a file's bytes, commits, bare remotes and tags, and stand-ins that read their input or are run with matching arguments
The Node steps' coverage (c8, coverage/lcov.info) goes to SonarQube Cloud beside the Python's

release.scope: the published release v0.2.1 of pubtest
